steps.title: Retrieval strengthens memory
steps.content: Trying to recall an idea is itself part of learning. A useful question asks you to retrieve the idea before showing the answer.

steps.title: Check your understanding
steps.prompt: What is the name of the practice of recalling information without first looking at the answer?
steps.explanation: Active recall, also called retrieval practice, makes the learner reconstruct the idea instead of only recognizing it.
